actualPromptText:
Create ONE production sprite sheet of ATARAX Controller for Aliens: Tantalus Frontier, animation death.
Identity lock: One original Tantalus Frontier ATARAX human network operator: realistic adult human proportions, readable human face, compact technical headset or low-profile open control helmet, dark industrial control suit, protected short cables, compact back module, chest-mounted neural console, forearm brace and one small secondary defensive sidearm only. Anthracite, gunmetal, black insulation, restrained amber status lamps and at most one small blue feedback light. The silhouette is technical and lightly protected, never heavy infantry, scientist recolor, cyber-mage, Xenoborg or controlled xenomorph. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile. All future pixels are original project art; no external model exists and no licensed character may be used as a visual substitute.
Archetype ATARAX Controller; modifier Standard. This profile has its own authored source; do not silently reuse or recolor another profile.
Animation: Lethal impact, loss of support, fall and terminal motionless body; never reuse this for nonlethal hurt.
Exactly eight individually authored chronological poses, four columns by two rows, strict row-major order. One character per cell. Each pose wholly inside its cell with generous equal gutters.
Strict gameplay side view facing RIGHT, no camera rotation, no perspective change. Retain identical skull, limbs, materials, colors, outfit and proportions across all poses and all clips.
Use one consistent physical scale and ground contact line. Full body and entire tail or weapon visible, no cut limbs, no cell overlap, no labels or grid lines, no logo, no UI.
True transparent RGBA background if available; otherwise a perfectly flat pure magenta background, no shadow, checkerboard or scenery. No interpolation or duplicates.
Preserve the supplied reference design as closely as possible; the output remains subject to visual review, not a guaranteed 1:1 replica.
